comparison.objective: Fit an end bracket to a loose DIN rail and tighten its clamp screw; candidate adjusts and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Bracing a rail while mounting a bracket and driving one screw differs from using a driver and wrench on coupled screw/nut hardware to preserve a calibrated setting.
comparison.success_condition: Bracket seated flush and tightened to 0.5 Nm with rail motion limited versus 90° stop retained within tolerance through three cycles.
comparison.reason: This is the closest general assembly/tool-use record, but it lacks the candidate’s essential set-then-lock countertorque and functional-retention test.
